newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO's Fukushima reactor back to full operations.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO's Fukushima reactor back to full operations.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc (TEPCO) said on Wednesday that its 784,000-kilowatt (kw) nuclear reactor in northern Japan is back running at full capacity.

The unit, one of six reactors at the Fukushima No. 1 nuclear power plant on the Pacific coast, had been running at about 70 percent capacity, or 550,000 kw, as a precaution after a leakage of a small amount of radioactive coolant from one of two back-up pumps at the reactor on Sunday.
TEPCO later found that a tiny foreign object in a water seal in the pump caused the leakage, and replaced the part.
The leak had no impact on the environment, TEPCO said.
